title: Govt Approves Introduction of 1 Billion Polymer Banknotes Each of ₹10 and ₹20 for Field Trials
summary: Center approved field trials of 1 billion pieces of ₹10 and 1 billion pieces of ₹20 polymer banknotes under RBI Act Section 25.
